utility.name: eBPF tracing tools
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Installs eBPF-based runtime tracing tools for observing program behaviour from the kernel: Aqua Security's Tracee (pinned release, verified against its SHA-256), which records process, file and network events and flags suspicious behaviour with built-in signatures, and bpftrace for one-line custom traces. Both need root and a kernel with BTF (Debian 12 and later).
utility.software_license: Apache v2 (Tracee user space and bpftrace), GPLv2 (Tracee eBPF programs)
